+"""Standalone copy of Click's POSIX ``raw_terminal`` helper.
+
+This module can be imported by file path without importing Click. It
+vendors ``click._termui_impl.raw_terminal`` (POSIX branch) unchanged as
+:func:`vendored_raw_terminal`, together with the ``isatty`` helper it
+depends on, and adds :func:`vendored_raw_terminal_variant`, which yields
+``(fd, "raw")`` instead of just ``fd``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import contextlib
+import os
+import sys
+import typing as t
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_raw_terminal", "vendored_raw_terminal_variant"]
+
+
+def isatty(stream: t.IO[t.Any]) -> bool:
+    try:
+        return stream.isatty()
+    except Exception:
+        return False
+
+
+if sys.platform != "win32" and os.name != "nt":
+    import termios
+    import tty
+
+    @contextlib.contextmanager
+    def vendored_raw_terminal() -> cabc.Iterator[int]:
+        f: t.TextIO | None
+        fd: int
+
+        if not isatty(sys.stdin):
+            f = open("/dev/tty")
+            fd = f.fileno()
+        else:
+            fd = sys.stdin.fileno()
+            f = None
+
+        try:
+            old_settings = termios.tcgetattr(fd)
+
+            try:
+                tty.setraw(fd)
+                yield fd
+            finally:
+                termios.tcsetattr(fd, termios.TCSADRAIN, old_settings)
+                sys.stdout.flush()
+
+                if f is not None:
+                    f.close()
+        except termios.error:
+            pass
+
+    @contextlib.contextmanager
+    def vendored_raw_terminal_variant() -> cabc.Iterator[tuple[int, str]]:
+        """Like :func:`vendored_raw_terminal`, but yield ``(fd, "raw")``."""
+        with vendored_raw_terminal() as fd:
+            yield fd, "raw"

@@ -0,0 +1,163 @@
+import importlib.util
+import io
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import termios
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+_PATH = Path(__file__).parents[1] / "src" / "standalone_wave6_raw_terminal.py"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def mod(monkeypatch):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_wave6_raw_terminal", _PATH
+    )
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+class FakeTTYStdin(io.StringIO):
+    def __init__(self, tty=True, fd=7):
+        super().__init__()
+        self._tty = tty
+        self._fd = fd
+
+    def isatty(self):
+        return self._tty
+
+    def fileno(self):
+        return self._fd
+
+
+class FakeDevTTY:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.closed = False
+
+    def fileno(self):
+        return 11
+
+    def close(self):
+        self.closed = True
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def calls(monkeypatch, mod):
+    log = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "stdin", FakeTTYStdin())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "stdout", io.StringIO())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        mod.termios, "tcgetattr", lambda fd: log.append(("get", fd)) or ["old"]
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mod.tty, "setraw", lambda fd: log.append(("raw", fd)))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        mod.termios,
+        "tcsetattr",
+        lambda fd, when, attrs: log.append(("set", fd, when, attrs)),
+    )
+    return log
+
+
+def test_import_does_not_load_click():
+    code = (
+        "import importlib.util, sys;"
+        f"s = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', {str(_PATH)!r});"
+        "m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m);"
+        "assert not any(n == 'click' or n.startswith('click.') for n in sys.modules)"
+    )
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], check=True)
+
+
+def test_exports(mod):
+    assert set(mod.__all__) == {
+        "vendored_raw_terminal",
+        "vendored_raw_terminal_variant",
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("name", "expected"),
+    [("vendored_raw_terminal", 7), ("vendored_raw_terminal_variant", (7, "raw"))],
+)
+def test_normal(mod, calls, name, expected):
+    with getattr(mod, name)() as value:
+        assert value == expected
+        assert calls == [("get", 7), ("raw", 7)]
+
+    assert calls[-1] == ("set", 7, termios.TCSADRAIN, ["old"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("name", "expected"),
+    [("vendored_raw_terminal", 11), ("vendored_raw_terminal_variant", (11, "raw"))],
+)
+def test_not_a_tty_opens_dev_tty(mod, calls, monkeypatch, name, expected):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "stdin", FakeTTYStdin(tty=False))
+    dev = FakeDevTTY()
+    opened = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        mod, "open", lambda path: opened.append(path) or dev, raising=False
+    )
+
+    with getattr(mod, name)() as value:
+        assert value == expected
+        assert not dev.closed
+
+    assert opened == ["/dev/tty"]
+    assert dev.closed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "name", ["vendored_raw_terminal", "vendored_raw_terminal_variant"]
+)
+def test_empty_body(mod, calls, name):
+    with getattr(mod, name)():
+        pass
+
+    assert [c[0] for c in calls] == ["get", "raw", "set"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "name", ["vendored_raw_terminal", "vendored_raw_terminal_variant"]
+)
+def test_body_exception_restores_and_propagates(mod, calls, name):
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        with getattr(mod, name)():
+            raise KeyError("boom")
+
+    assert calls[-1] == ("set", 7, termios.TCSADRAIN, ["old"])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "name", ["vendored_raw_terminal", "vendored_raw_terminal_variant"]
+)
+def test_termios_error_suppressed_without_yield(mod, calls, monkeypatch, name):
+    def fail(fd):
+        raise termios.error("not a terminal")
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mod.termios, "tcgetattr", fail)
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="didn't yield"):
+        with getattr(mod, name)():
+            pass
+
+    assert calls == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "name", ["vendored_raw_terminal", "vendored_raw_terminal_variant"]
+)
+def test_termios_error_in_body_suppressed(mod, calls, name):
+    with getattr(mod, name)():
+        raise termios.error("lost terminal")
+
+    assert calls[-1][0] == "set"
+
+
+def test_isatty(mod):
+    assert mod.isatty(FakeTTYStdin(tty=True))
+    assert not mod.isatty(FakeTTYStdin(tty=False))
+    assert not mod.isatty(object())
notes:
Copied the POSIX raw_terminal body verbatim as vendored_raw_terminal (plus the isatty helper) under a non-Windows platform guard, and added a contextmanager wrapper vendored_raw_terminal_variant that yields (fd, "raw"). The tests load the module by file path, mock termios/tty/open/stdin, and cover normal, empty-body, body-exception, termios.error and no-click-import cases.
